referenceDna.annotatedDescription: The official Mister Sparky electrical services homepage was inspected in paired desktop and mobile full-page captures. The page opens with a garage and electrician photograph is interrupted by a red halftone message circle and ZIP finder. It uses thin red availability strip over a white service bar with a yellow booking control. The visual system relies on bold compact sans headings and short neutral supporting copy; surfaces include black, white, service red and accents include electric yellow, red. Imagery is uniformed electrician photographs in large circular crops plus household electrical context. The page then runs through service navigation, photo and halftone opening, black electrical service grid, customer review rail, human reassurance chapter, four benefit statements, local electrician explanation, expert articles and footer. Its service presentation is dark squared tiles with yellow line icons and short task labels. Mobile changes to reduce the hero to one readable photo and message, stack the service tiles, and keep booking and ZIP input touch sized. Transfer only the layout rhythm and decision path. Do not copy brand character, exact halftone shape, uniforms, reviews, guarantees, or emergency availability claims.
